about: Naproxen (Naprosyn SR) is supplied monthly from October 2025 to May 2026 with no proton pump inhibitor or H2 antagonist, and the record holds a peptic ulcer disease line.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about peptic ulcer or bleeding history. Voltaren (diclofenac, an NSAID) is supplied monthly by brand name only from February to September 2026 with no stomach-protecting medicine.
The record holds a peptic ulcer disease line and naproxen is supplied monthly, but Pantoloc (pantoprazole) is supplied every month with it, so there is no finding.
